description: This file defines a class `FormatWithJobCategory` that implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. Its purpose is to fetch a job category by ID and return its name, providing a formatted value for display or processing within the HRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategory
classes.description: A formatter that retrieves a JobCategory by ID and returns its name as a string.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches a JobCategory by ID and returns the category's name if found; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the JobCategoryService instance, creating it if necessary.
